opportunities.title: Structure-Guided Allosteric JAK2 V617F JH2 Mutant-Selective Inhibitor / PROTAC Degrader Design
opportunities.wet_lab_execution_model: Zero internal wet lab required for hit-to-lead: pair in-silico MD/free-energy perturbation (FEP+) & generative pocket design on PDB 4FVR/6E2Q/8BAK/8EX2 (V617F JH2) vs 4FVP (WT JH2) with fee-for-service biochemical binding panels (Eurofins DiscoverX / Reaction Biology JH2 vs JH1 selectivity assays + isogenic Ba/F3 EPOR V617F vs WT cell lines).
opportunities.problem_wedge: All 4 FDA-approved JAK inhibitors (ruxolitinib, fedratinib, pacritinib, momelotinib) are Type I ATP-competitive binders of the conserved JH1 catalytic domain, inhibiting wild-type JAK2 alongside mutant JAK2 V617F. This causes dose-limiting anemia and thrombocytopenia, induces JAK2 heterodimer persistence, fails to eradicate mutant HSC clones, and leads to ~50% ruxolitinib discontinuation within 3 years (median post-discontinuation OS: 11-23 months). While first-gen reversible JH2 binders (INCB160058, NCT06313593) and Type II DFG-out binders (AJ1-11095, NCT06343805) just entered Phase 1, catalytic JH2-selective degraders (PROTACs/molecular glues) that eliminate scaffolding remain wide open.
opportunities.solution_blueprint: Design next-generation small-molecule allosteric binders or V617F-selective heterobifunctional degraders (PROTACs recruiting CRBN/VHL/DCAF) targeting the mutated JH2 pseudokinase pocket (p.Val617Phe aromatic pi-stacking rearrangement) achieving >50x selectivity over wild-type JAK2/JAK1/TYK2 to enable catalytic clonal clearance without myelosuppression.

unit_economics.orphan_market_benchmark: ~15,000-25,000 US Myelofibrosis patients (~50-60% JAK2 V617F+) + >150,000 Polycythemia Vera (>95% JAK2 V617F+) & Essential Thrombocythemia expansion; Ruxolitinib exceeds $4.5B/yr global revenue.
unit_economics.exit_or_revenue_comps: Preclinical/Phase 1 mutant-selective kinase assets transact for $80M-$400M+ upfront/option packages (benchmarks: Prelude-Incyte INCB160058 alliance, Ajax Therapeutics AJ1-11095); single-asset MF biotechs exit at $1.7B-$2.9B.

opportunities.regulatory_pathway: FDA Orphan Drug Designation (7-yr exclusivity, 100% waiver of FY2026 $4,682,003 PDUFA filing fee, 25% QCTE tax credit) + Fast Track in post-ruxolitinib MF.
first_90_days_milestones: Benchmark structural dynamics and exit vectors across PDB 4FVR, 6E2Q, 8BAK, and 8EX2 (JAK2 V617F JH2) vs PDB 4FVP (WT JH2) against ChEMBL CHEMBL2971 ligands.
Run virtual screen / generative ternary-complex design optimizing JH2-V617F vs JH2-WT delta-delta-G selectivity and non-JH1 hinge binding.
Order 30-50 custom/Make-on-Demand analogs or linker-warhead pairs ($25K-$45K) and screen in outsourced JH2-WT vs JH2-V617F TR-FRET competition and HiBiT degradation assays.
Submit NCI SBIR Phase I ($400K) and MPN Research Foundation MPN Challenge ($250K) LOI with initial selectivity curves.

opportunities.title: Composite Surrogate Endpoint & AI Digital Pathology Platform Solving the Phase 3 SVR35/TSS50 Crisis
opportunities.wet_lab_execution_model: 100% software / computational pathology & digital biomarker platform using digitized bone marrow H&E/reticulin WSIs, NGS VAF kinetics, and high-frequency wearable/ePRO feeds.
opportunities.problem_wedge: Between 2024 and 2026, three major frontline Phase 3 combination trials—TRANSFORM-1 (navitoclax, NCT04472598), MANIFEST-2 (pelabresib, NCT04603495), and SENTRY (selinexor, NCT04562389)—hit Spleen Volume Reduction (SVR35) yet missed strict Total Symptom Score (TSS50) statistical cutoffs due to noisy diary scores, while IMpactMF (imetelstat, NCT04576156) failed on Overall Survival in Oct 2026. Meanwhile, manual WHO marrow fibrosis grading (MF-0 to MF-3) has 30-40% inter-pathologist discordance.
opportunities.solution_blueprint: Build a regulatory-grade composite disease-modification biomarker platform combining foundation-model reticulin/megakaryocyte WSI morphometry, longitudinal JAK2 V617F / HMR VAF clearance, and passive wearable + micro-sampled MF-SAF v4.0 ePROs—aligned with the FDA Rare Disease Endpoint Advancement (RDEA) program.

unit_economics.orphan_market_benchmark: 30+ active Phase 1-3 Myelofibrosis clinical trials globally spending $30M-$120M per trial; B2B SaaS biopharma endpoint & central pathology contracts average $300K-$1.5M per trial.

opportunities.title: Single-Cell Megakaryocyte-Stroma Drug Repurposing Screen for Direct Bone Marrow Fibrosis Reversal
opportunities.wet_lab_execution_model: Computational single-cell perturbation modeling across human MF scRNA-seq atlases + outsourced validation in primary MPN CD34+ megakaryocyte / stromal co-cultures or 3D marrow organoids via academic core/CRO.
opportunities.problem_wedge: Zero FDA-approved drugs reverse established bone marrow reticulin/collagen fibrosis. Even under JAK inhibition, aberrant megakaryocytes secrete S100A8/A9 alarmins, TGF-beta1/3, CXCL4, and PDGF, locking LepR+/GLI1+ mesenchymal stromal cells in a collagen-producing myofibroblast state.
opportunities.solution_blueprint: Pair human MF CD34+/megakaryocyte scRNA-seq (GSE144568) and mesenchymal stromal scRNA-seq (GSE156644) with drug-repurposing perturbation graphs (Every Cure / LINCS / Tahoe-100M) to identify non-myelosuppressive clinical-stage or generic oral compounds that collapse the S100A8/A9-GLI1-TGFb fibrotic loop as an orthogonal add-on to any JAK inhibitor.

unit_economics.initial_validation_budget_usd: $65,000 - $180,000 (computational ranking + 12-compound combo screen in patient-derived CD34+/stromal co-cultures via academic core)
unit_economics.orphan_market_benchmark: 505(b)(2) reformulation or fixed-dose combination with 7-year FDA Orphan Drug exclusivity cuts pre-IND cost by 60-75% and addresses 100% of MF genotypes (JAK2+, CALR+, MPL+, triple-negative).
unit_economics.exit_or_revenue_comps: Fastest path to Investigator-Initiated Trial (IIT) Phase 1b/2 proof-of-concept in ruxolitinib suboptimal responders (<$2.5M via MPNRF Challenge + FDA Orphan Products Grant).

first_90_days_milestones: Reconstruct ligand-receptor fibrotic circuits (CellChat/NicheNet) between MF megakaryocytes (GSE144568) and LepR+/GLI1+ stromal myofibroblasts (GSE156644).
Cross-score candidate transcriptional reversals against marrow-penetrant clinical-stage or generic compounds with zero platelet/hemoglobin toxicity.
Execute a $45K-$75K Sponsored Research Agreement with an academic MPN lab to test top 8 combinations in human MF stromal co-cultures.
File provisional method-of-use and synergistic combination patents prior to publication.

opportunities.title: Regulatory-Grade RWE External Control Arm & No-Washout Clinical Trial Matching Engine
opportunities.wet_lab_execution_model: Zero wet lab; FHIR/EHR patient-authorized data sync complementary to existing registries (MPN PROGRESSion Registry NCT07362225, HealthTree) + automated community oncology trial routing.
opportunities.problem_wedge: Median OS after ruxolitinib discontinuation is 11-23 months, yet >70% of US MF patients are treated in generalist community clinics. Worse, patients refuse salvage trials that require a 14-28 day ruxolitinib washout ('washout terror' from cytokine rebound), while sponsors pay $30K-$60K/patient recruiting Best-Available-Therapy control arms.
opportunities.solution_blueprint: Build a FHIR-native longitudinal companion and automated trial-matching engine that tracks CBC/transfusion velocity, MIPSS70+ v2.0 NGS risk, and RR6 ruxolitinib-failure criteria—specifically filtering for add-on / overlap-bridging trials (e.g., POIESIS NCT06479135) while licensing FDA-auditable External Control Arms (ECAs) to Phase 2/3 sponsors.

unit_economics.orphan_market_benchmark: Rare hematology trial recruitment commands $8,000-$25,000 per enrolled/screened patient, plus $500K-$2M+ per biopharma External Control Arm licensing contract.
unit_economics.exit_or_revenue_comps: Capital-efficient rare-disease RWE & trial-acceleration model (Citizen Health / PicnicHealth / HealthTree benchmark) reaching cash-flow positivity on 3-5 sponsor contracts.

opportunities.regulatory_pathway: IRB-approved patient-mediated HIPAA Right-of-Access platform aligned with FDA Guidance on Real-World Data (RWD) External Control Arms.
first_90_days_milestones: Parse structured inclusion/exclusion criteria (platelets, Hb, prior JAKi washout vs add-on rules, TP53/JAK2 status) across all active MF trials via ClinicalTrials.gov API v2.

opportunities.title: AI Allo-HSCT Timing, Cytopenia Switch & Shared-Decision Concierge ('The 10% to 35% Bridge')
opportunities.wet_lab_execution_model: Pure care-delivery, clinical decision support (CDS), and reimbursed Remote Therapeutic Monitoring (RTM/CCM) infrastructure.
opportunities.problem_wedge: Allogeneic stem cell transplant (allo-HSCT) is the ONLY curative therapy for MF (5-yr OS ~50-60%), yet <10-15% of eligible patients ever receive it. Community oncologists lack molecularly calibrated timing tools (balancing MIPSS70+ v2.0 progression risk against 20-36% transplant NRM) and struggle to titrate switches across ruxolitinib, momelotinib (anemia), and pacritinib (platelets <50k).
opportunities.solution_blueprint: Deploy a reimbursed RTM/CCM symptom & transfusion monitoring service paired with transparent NCCN/MIPSS70+/MTSS clinical decision support and BMT Center-of-Excellence referral navigation—catching high-molecular-risk (ASXL1, SRSF2, U2AF1, TP53) patients in the optimal pre-blast transplant window.

unit_economics.initial_validation_budget_usd: $150,000 - $400,000 (MPN-SAF ePRO + MIPSS70+/MTSS CDS workflow + pilot with 2 academic BMT centers and regional oncology clinics)
unit_economics.orphan_market_benchmark: Prevents $100K-$250K/yr avoidable transfusion/splenomegaly admissions and blast-phase crises; monetizes via Medicare RTM/PCM CPT codes + BMT Center-of-Excellence value contracts.
unit_economics.exit_or_revenue_comps: Scalable across all Myeloproliferative Neoplasms (>300,000 US PV/ET/MF patients) and MDS (~60,000 US patients).

opportunities.regulatory_pathway: Non-device Clinical Decision Support (CDS) exemption under 21st Century Cures Act (displaying transparent NCCN/MIPSS70+/MTSS clinical logic to clinicians) + HIPAA BAA.
first_90_days_milestones: Encode transparent RR6 (Response to Ruxolitinib after 6 months), MIPSS70+ v2.0, and MTSS (Myelofibrosis Transplant Scoring System) calculators with longitudinal EHR lab ingestion.
Co-design shared-decision transplant & JAKi-switch guides with academic BMT directors and MPN Advocacy & Education International.

epidemiology.us_incidence: 1.0 - 1.56 per 100,000 person-years (~3,500 - 5,000 new US cases/year including PMF and post-PV/ET MF)
epidemiology.us_prevalence_estimate: 15,000 - 25,000+ living patients in the US (~4-6 per 100,000; well under the 200,000 FDA Orphan Drug ceiling)
epidemiology.jak2_v617f_driver_share: ~50% - 60% of Primary Myelofibrosis (PMF) and post-ET MF; >95% of Post-Polycythemia Vera MF
epidemiology.other_drivers: CALR exon 9 indels (~20-35%, surface-targetable via mAb INCA033989), MPL W515L/K (~5-8%), Triple-Negative (~10%), plus HMR co-mutations (ASXL1, SRSF2, U2AF1, EZH2, IDH1/2, TP53)
epidemiology.median_survival: ~5-7 years overall from diagnosis; drops to 11-23 months following ruxolitinib discontinuation (3-4 months upon blast-phase AML transformation).

biological_tractability.causal_mechanism: A somatic point mutation (G1849T -> Val617Phe) in exon 14 encoding the JH2 pseudokinase domain of JAK2 disrupts autoinhibition of the JH1 catalytic kinase domain, driving constitutive cytokine-independent STAT3/STAT5, MAPK, and PI3K/AKT signaling via EPOR, MPL, and GCSFR.
why_highly_tractable_now: Validated JH2 Allosteric Pocket: High-resolution crystal structures of V617F JH2 (PDB: 4FVR, 6E2Q, 8BAK, 8EX2) vs WT JH2 (PDB: 4FVP) enable selective small molecules/PROTACs sparing WT JAK2, with first-in-class clinical entrants INCB160058 (NCT06313593) and Type II binder AJ1-11095 (NCT06343805) de-risking the biology.

Intracellular Engineering Imperative: Unlike mutant CALR (which traffics to the cell surface and responds to mAb INCA033989, NCT06034002), JAK2 V617F is strictly intracellular—demanding JH2 small molecules, PROTAC degraders, or TCR-mimetics.

Quantitative Blood Clonal Biomarker: Peripheral blood ddPCR/NGS directly measures JAK2 V617F Variant Allele Frequency (VAF), enabling rapid Phase 1b pharmacodynamic readouts of true stem-cell clearance.

2024-2026 Late-Stage Pipeline Reset: Discontinuations of navitoclax (TRANSFORM-1, NCT04472598) and imetelstat (IMpactMF, NCT04576156, Oct 2026 OS futility) plus SVR35/TSS50 discordance in MANIFEST-2 (pelabresib) and SENTRY (selinexor, which showed a June 2026 >50% OS hazard reduction signal alongside BOREAS/POIESIS navtemadlin and Fast-Track PIM1 inhibitor nuvisertib TP-3654) prove the urgent market need for non-myelosuppressive clonal & antifibrotic therapies and modernized digital endpoints.
biological_tractability.fibrotic_microenvironment: Clonal JAK2 V617F megakaryocytes secrete S100A8/A9 alarmins, TGF-beta1/3, CXCL4, PDGF, and IL-1b/IL-6 that reprogram LepR+/GLI1+ mesenchymal stromal cells into collagen-depositing myofibroblasts, destroying marrow hematopoiesis.

approved_therapies: Ruxolitinib (Jakafi, Nov 2011; Jakafi XR once-daily approved May 1, 2026; COMFORT-I/II NCT00952289/NCT00934544) - Type I JH1 JAK1/JAK2 inhibitor
Fedratinib (Inrebic, Aug 2019; JAKARTA NCT01437787) - Type I JH1 JAK2/FLT3 inhibitor (carries Wernicke encephalopathy Boxed Warning)
Pacritinib (Vonjo, Feb 2022 Accelerated Approval; PERSIST-2 NCT02055781) - Type I JH1 JAK2/IRAK1/ACVR1 inhibitor for severe thrombocytopenia (platelets <50x10^9/L)
Momelotinib (Ojjaara, Sept 2023; MOMENTUM NCT04173494) - Type I JH1 JAK1/JAK2/ACVR1 inhibitor improving anemia via hepcidin suppression
core_failure_mechanisms: Zero WT vs Mutant Selectivity: JH1 ATP sites are identical in WT and V617F JAK2; blocking WT JAK2 suppresses EPOR/TPOR signaling, causing dose-limiting iatrogenic anemia and thrombocytopenia.

Type I Heterodimer Persistence & Clonal Evolution: Chronic Type I inhibition stabilizes hyperphosphorylated JAK2 that trans-activates via JAK1/TYK2, allowing malignant HSCs to persist and acquire ASXL1, RAS, or multi-hit TP53 mutations without reversing marrow fibrosis.
The Ruxolitinib Discontinuation Cliff: ~50% of patients stop ruxolitinib within 3 years (~70-75% by 5 years), facing 11-23 months median OS.
Allo-HSCT Bottleneck: Curative transplant reaches <10-15% of eligible patients due to median diagnosis age 65-70, 20-36% non-relapse mortality (NRM), and 15-30% relapse.

ethical_discovery_guidelines: 1. Do Not Fragment or Spam Communities: Never deploy bots to post, DM, or cold-solicit in r/mpn, HealthUnlocked, Smart Patients, or private Facebook groups; partner through foundation leadership and moderators.
2. Zero Unconsented Scraping of Patient Narratives: Never scrape identifiable usernames, health histories, or gated forum posts to train models or build marketing lists.
3. Fair-Market-Value Patient Advisory Compensation: Compensate patient and caregiver advisors ($100-$250/hr) for 30-45 minute low-fatigue co-design sessions and share plain-language results back.

4. Clinical Safety & IRB/HIPAA Rigor: Never offer medical advice or critique prescribed JAKi regimens; secure central IRB review (WCG/Advarra) and explicit HIPAA authorization before ingesting EHR/FHIR or genomic data.
